title: 第八章 感情
content_zh:
艾妮尔的话一出口，整个酒馆都安静了下来，静静的听着他们吞咽口水的声音，艾妮尔慢慢的转身，“他在哪里？”

    “他……他……”服务生犹豫着，不知道要不要说，推了推靠在柜台上的那个贵族，“胡子，要不要说啊？”

    “当然说了，哈哈哈~”刚才还一本正经的胡子大叔，突然哈哈的大笑了起来，“没想到首领他竟然有了这个打算，真是的，他怎么不早说，不然我早就给他找一个了，男人啊！还是需要女人的。”

    “哈哈哈~胡子说的对，首领也是男人啊！哈哈哈~”笑声一阵盖过一阵。

    听着这样的笑声，艾妮尔的眉头慢慢的皱起，最后紧紧的锁了起来，可是她强压着心中的不快，“他在哪里？”

    “他出去了，安排好你们的事后他就出去了。”胡子回答着邪邪的笑了起来，“怎么？这么快就开始想他了？对了，应该怎么说呢？其实是求了婚的，应该就是未婚夫吧？”

    “是啊！未婚夫！未婚夫！”酒馆里的其它贵族不断的起哄。

    “出去？”艾妮尔对他们的嬉笑充耳不闻，望了一眼紧闭的窗户和大门，“现在是白天！”

    “是啊！不过我们的首领强大到不怕阳光！”胡子得意的炫耀着，转身向着服务生，“再给我来一杯！”

    “还一杯？胡子，你上个月的帐还没结清呢！”虽然服务生嘴上这么说，不过还是给胡子又倒了杯爱沦特，省着点喝！

    “放心！过几天我就有任务了，到时一定把明年的酒钱一起付了。”胡子端起来，一口喝了半杯，完全没把对方的提醒放在心上。

    看着这些跟佣兵一样的贵族们，艾妮尔只是摇了摇头，转身向刚才的来路走去。

    “等等！你去哪里？”胡子喊道。

    “回去睡觉！”艾妮尔没有回头。

    “睡觉？”胡子一愣。

    “我是吸血鬼，白天睡觉不是很正常么？”艾妮尔穿过小门时，最后留下这么一句。

    “可是……”胡子呆呆的看着她的离去，“我们这里好象没有这种规定。”

    “所以说你们已经不是真正的吸血鬼了。”艾妮尔早就没了身影，不过她的回答却如此清晰可见，回味着这话的意思，胡子愣愣的走到萨尔他们一桌，坐了下来。

    爱夏有些好笑的拍了拍胡子的肩膀，“怎么？被教训了？”

    “不……不是，只是有点……”胡子说不出来，不知道为什么，那句话一直堵在心里，有点难受，却又不讨厌。

    “算了，她很特别。”爱夏笑了笑，带着一点点惆怅，还有一点点说不清楚的味道。

    艾妮尔听着他们的对话，苦笑了下，继续向前走去，这些贵族不算太强，数量也不多，奥利维斯说过的几万在哪里？他们又有多强。

    一边思考着，艾妮尔一边往回走，穿过一个个的房间，目光略微的扫了一下，每个房间都差不多，跟军人一样的统一，只是不够整洁。
content_en:
"Skeleton?" After hearing such an answer, Enel looked up at the other party in confusion. She really couldn't believe her ears. In her opinion, this was a name that would never appear in her mind again, because the moment she left it, she had already removed it from her heart.It was completely wiped out, and now, someone actually mentioned this name to her again, and it was him. So, she stared at the other person closely, hoping to see something in the other person's eyes, but she was disappointed. The other person's eyes were dead, not even angry, what else could there be?Is Yimi'er's disappearance really such a big blow to him?

"Yes! Sqirudun!" But he was extremely sure, because that was why he came here, and at this time, there were only these four words in his mind.

"Why?" Enel needed a reason, and it was a strong enough reason, otherwise it would be absolutely impossible for her to return to that place that was only sorrow and torture for her.

"Because..." He really opened his eyes at this time, but when he met Enel's gaze, he couldn't help but froze and hesitated to speak.

"If you can't give me a convincing reason, then I think she should go to heaven, at least there is her future there." Before Anel said anything, God had already spoken, because he rarely comes to the human world, and if he comes, then he will not return empty-handed. This is related to his self-confidence and dignity.

"She..." He hesitated, as if he didn't know whether he should say it or not, but he had to say it.

"It seems you have no excuse at all," God asserted.

"No! She is a hunter, and only in Skeleton can there be a living space for hunters." As a result, he was so anxious that he spat out all the words locked in his throat. Just hearing such an answer, Enel was stunned, and God smiled, "So, you hope that she will always be a hunter with bloody hands?"

"I..." Only then did he realize what he had said. In a panic, he turned his eyes from God to Enel, but it was better not to look. The sight made him want to bite off his tongue even more. Enel was actually crying, and tears gradually crawled from the corners of her eyes to cover her almost pale cheeks. However, on her face, he heard blood, red and black, but there were no tears.Therefore, he didn't know what to say or what he could say when he opened his mouth. He was helpless to deal with her tears except heartache.

"Hunter?" However, God would not be speechless, and he did not want to let go of such a good opportunity. "But, I think letting her become a hunter is torture and underestimation of her."

"But...but she just can't go to heaven." He had nothing to say when facing Enel, but it was completely different when facing God. He argued vigorously, but there was only that sentence without any explanation, so his words seemed so weak that even he himself was worried about it.

"Why? If it's the same reason as before, then there's no need to say it anymore. I've already heard it clearly. I'm a hunter!" Enel finally spoke, but her tone was not as sad as her tears. It was just cold, so cold that even the god next to her almost trembled.

"I...I'm not..." He was speechless for the first time, "I mean..."

"Forget it, since you can't explain it clearly, how about I do it?" Enel looked at the other party squarely, her eyes not flickering. "In your heart, I will always be just a hunter with bloody hands. No matter whether my heart is painful for this, or whether I have left Schiden, or whether I have left Stoker, I will always be in your heart.They are all the hunters with stained faces. I don’t have the sweetness of Yi Mier, nor the charm of Aisha. What I have is coldness and ruthlessness, so you can go far away. From now on, there is nothing and no relationship between us. You go your own way and go wherever you like, whether it is a small building in Skirton or an old castle in Myri, and I..."

Seeing Enel turn around, God smiled and stretched out his hand, "Welcome to heaven!"

"Thank you!" Enel took out her hand without hesitation. At this moment, she was truly dead, her heart was dead, and her soul was dead. She had nothing to ask for, no expectations, only coldness and ruthlessness, and a dead heart and only a strong soul left.

"Enel!" Watching her turn around, watching her holding hands with others, watching her following others and walking away, he was anxious and wanted to chase her, but when he saw Enel looking back and smiling, he could no longer lift his legs, because he could see clearly that Enel's eyes were saying, "If you continue to follow, the result will be the hunter and the prey. Don't forget, I am a hunter."

"Hey! What should we... we... do?" Seeing that God had already ascended to the sky, he disappeared at the end of the clouds.

"Let's continue to be our students!" Spirit Snake curled her lips and pretended not to care.

"Go back!" Vero turned and walked directly to the accommodation area.

"But...but what about divine revelation? Why is there no divine revelation?" Kesha was also confused and at a loss. After all, she was looking forward to more than just meeting God. She wanted God's revelation about the future, preferably about her future, because she was also at a loss about the path of life and her own future. She didn't know where or how to find it, so she would shrink in this seminary, stay alone, and not touch anything outside., whether it is a favor or an accident, to her, they seem to be on the other side of the other shore, looking at it from a distance, but out of reach, because she does not have the courage to take that step and cross that chasm, even if it is only a millimeter wide, she does not dare. She is afraid, afraid that the other side of the other side is the world she remembered when she was a child. It is dark and cruel and not suitable for her at all. Whether it was a child or now, her heart and soul are the same weak.

"This is the divine revelation! Isn't it?" At this time, Locke walked out of the white mist behind them, as if he had been standing there, watching the arrival of the gods until the return of the gods.

"But..." Kesha turned back and looked at Locke, who looked unhappy. She was confused but seemed to understand something. There were vague things that couldn't be said. She felt more than words.

"Everyone, go back! As for the assessment, the test will begin tomorrow!" Locke turned to look at them and announced loudly.

"What? There's still an assessment?" the eldest lady asked in confusion.

"Yes! That was a divine revelation just now. No one said that this divine revelation was an assessment for you." With that said, Locke turned around and walked away with a serious face, leaving a group of classmates in a daze and slowly thinking about it.

"Hey! This is God!" With that said, the spirit snake also left, but his sigh could not hide the helplessness and regret at the corner of his mouth. The last thing he wanted to see was this scene, but it happened in front of him from beginning to end. Therefore, when he passed by the person who came in to cause trouble, he said with a trace of anger, "Hunter? You might as well say prey!"
